1.why: All screens use a clean sans-serif typeface with comfortable spacing and generous white space around the content card.

2.why: All instruction text is plain sentence-case with no italics, no all-caps, and never more than one or two short lines per step.

3.why: The screenshots are desktop-width; the single-column card looks adaptable, but readability at an actual mobile size is not demonstrated and the wide Logs panel could overflow small screens.

4.why: Instructions are short plain sentences (e.g., 'Save this setup secret in your authenticator now.'), though they assume familiarity with terms like MFA and authenticator.

5.why: Some inputs show examples (prefilled +15551234567, placeholder 'ABCD-EFGH-IJKL', demo credentials), but the 6-digit verification and authenticator code fields show no example value.

6.why: Every step presents at most one or two short sentences, so no long block of text must be read to proceed.

7.why: The setup secret and recovery codes appear as selectable page text, but no copy button or other explicit copy affordance is visible.

8.why: The flow explicitly instructs the user to 'add it manually to your authenticator app' and no QR code or equivalent alternative appears in any step.

9.why: Standard email and password inputs are shown, but nothing in the screenshots demonstrates whether browser autofill or password managers are supported.

10.why: Each screen has a bold heading naming the current step and a single prominent blue primary button, though there is no overall progress indicator.

11.why: Each enrolment step asks for one main action, with only the post-enrolment settings screen offering multiple actions together (verify, regenerate, log out).

12.why: Some actions get explicit status messages ('Recovery code accepted and used.', 'MFA is enabled. 8 recovery codes remain.'), but others, such as sending the verification code, produce no explicit confirmation of what happened or what comes next.

13.why: Recovery codes can be regenerated and the error message invites trying again, but there is no reveal/hide control and no explicit resend option beyond the original 'Send verification code' button.

14.why: The only observed error, 'We could not complete that request. Please try again.', does not blame the user but fails to state what the problem was.

15.why: No countdowns, timers, or other time-pressure cues appear in any of the 15 steps, including on code-entry screens.
